en bænk.explanation: "En bænk" means "a bench", a long place to sit for several people, often in a park.

sentence.da: Vi sætter os på en **bænk** og hviler.
sentence.en: We sit down on a bench and rest.

en bærbar computer.explanation: "En bærbar computer" means "a laptop". Bærbar (portable) means you can carry it.

sentence.da: Jeg har en **bærbar computer** i min taske.
sentence.en: I have a laptop in my bag.

en bøde.explanation: "En bøde" means "a fine", money you must pay for breaking a rule. Use at få en bøde (to get a fine).

sentence.da: Jeg fik en **bøde**, fordi jeg parkerede forkert.
sentence.en: I got a fine because I parked in the wrong place.

en bøf.explanation: "En bøf" means "a steak", a piece of cooked meat, most often beef. A ground-meat patty is en hakkebøf (a ground beef patty).

sentence.da: Han steger en **bøf** på panden.
sentence.en: He is frying a steak in the pan.

en bøjle.explanation: "En bøjle" means "a hanger", for hanging clothes in a closet. The same word is in en tandbøjle (braces for teeth).

sentence.da: Jeg hænger skjorten på en **bøjle**.
sentence.en: I hang the shirt on a hanger.

en bølge.explanation: "En bølge" means "a wave" in the water. It is also used for other waves: en hedebølge (a heat wave).

sentence.da: En stor **bølge** ramte båden.
sentence.en: A big wave hit the boat.

en børnehave.explanation: "En børnehave" means "a kindergarten", for children from about three to six, before school starts. It is built from børn (children) and have (garden).

sentence.da: Min datter er fire og går i **børnehave**.
sentence.en: My daughter is four and goes to kindergarten.

en børnemenu.explanation: "En børnemenu" means "a kids' menu", a smaller meal for children at a restaurant. It is built from børn (children) and menu (menu).

sentence.da: Har I en **børnemenu** til mit barn?
sentence.en: Do you have a kids' menu for my child?

en børste.explanation: "En børste" means "a brush", for hair, shoes or cleaning. The same word is the verb at børste (to brush): Jeg børster tænder (I brush my teeth).

sentence.da: Jeg har en blød **børste** til mit hår.
sentence.en: I have a soft brush for my hair.

et bad.explanation: "Et bad" means "a bath" or "a shower". To take one, say at tage et bad (to have a bath or shower). Do not mix it up with et badeværelse (a bathroom) or at bade (to swim or bathe).

sentence.da: Jeg tager et **bad** hver morgen.
sentence.en: I take a shower every morning.

et badekar.explanation: "Et badekar" means "a bathtub", a tub you fill with water and lie in: Hun ligger i badekarret (She lies in the bathtub). A bruser (shower) has no tub.

sentence.da: Hun lægger sig i et **badekar** og slapper af.
sentence.en: She lies down in a bathtub and relaxes.

et badeværelse.explanation: "Et badeværelse" means "a bathroom", the room with the shower or bath. It is made from bad (bath) and værelse (room). To find a public toilet, ask for et toilet (a toilet), not badeværelse.

sentence.da: Vi har et lille **badeværelse** med bad.
sentence.en: We have a small bathroom with a shower.

et bagagebånd.explanation: "Et bagagebånd" means "a baggage carousel", the moving belt where you pick up your bags at the airport. It is built from bagage (baggage) and bånd (belt).

sentence.da: Vi venter ved **bagagebånd** nummer to.
sentence.en: We are waiting at baggage carousel number two.

et bagagerum.explanation: "Et bagagerum" means "a trunk", the storage space at the back of a car. It is built from bagage (luggage) and rum (room), so Danish says luggage room where English says trunk or boot.

sentence.da: Vores nye bil har et stort **bagagerum**.
sentence.en: Our new car has a big trunk.

et bageri.explanation: "Et bageri" means "a bakery", a shop that bakes and sells bread and cakes. To order there, say Jeg vil gerne have et rundstykke (I would like a bread roll).

sentence.da: Jeg køber brød og kager i et **bageri**.
sentence.en: I buy bread and cakes in a bakery.

et band.explanation: "Et band" means "a band", a group that plays music: Vi har et band (We have a band). Do not mix it up with et bånd (a ribbon or tape).

sentence.da: Vores **band** spiller til en fest i morgen.
sentence.en: Our band is playing at a party tomorrow.

et barn.explanation: "Et barn" means "a child", and also your own child at any age: mit barn (my child). The plural børn looks quite different from barn: to børn (two children).

sentence.da: Hun har et lille **barn** hjemme.
sentence.en: She has a small child at home.

et barnebarn.explanation: "Et barnebarn" means "a grandchild", literally a child's child, built from barn (child) twice. It covers both grandsons and granddaughters.

sentence.da: Min datters barn er mit **barnebarn**.
sentence.en: My daughter's child is my grandchild.

et batteri.explanation: "Et batteri" means "a battery", in a phone, a car or a toy. A battery is fladt (dead) when it is empty.

sentence.da: Mit **batteri** er næsten tomt.
sentence.en: My battery is almost empty.

et bed.explanation: "Et bed" means "a flower bed", a patch of soil where flowers grow. For a bed to sleep in, use en seng (a bed).

sentence.da: Der er mange røde blomster i mit **bed**.
sentence.en: There are many red flowers in my flower bed.

et behov.explanation: "Et behov" means "a need", something a person must have, like food or sleep.

sentence.da: Der er et stort **behov** for lærere.
sentence.en: There is a great need for teachers.

et beløb.explanation: "Et beløb" means "an amount" of money, such as what you have to pay. For an amount of other things, use en mængde (a quantity).

sentence.da: Det samlede **beløb** er tusind kroner.
sentence.en: The total amount is a thousand kroner.

et ben.explanation: "Et ben" means "a leg" and also "a bone"; the situation tells you which. Han har brækket benet literally says the leg, but means "He has broken his leg". The plural is the same as the single word: to ben (two legs).

sentence.da: En hund har fire **ben**.
sentence.en: A dog has four legs.

et besøg.explanation: "Et besøg" means "a visit". The plural is the same as the single word: to besøg (two visits). To be visiting someone, say på besøg: Jeg er på besøg hos min mor (I am visiting my mother).

sentence.da: Tak for dit **besøg**! Kom snart igen.
sentence.en: Thank you for your visit! Come again soon.

et betalingskort.explanation: "Et betalingskort" means "a payment card", a debit or credit card you pay with. It is made from betaling (payment) and kort (card). The plural is the same as the single word: to betalingskort (two cards).

sentence.da: Jeg betaler med mit **betalingskort**.
sentence.en: I pay with my payment card.

et bevis.explanation: "Et bevis" means "a proof", and also "evidence": Politiet har ikke noget bevis (The police have no evidence).

sentence.da: Jeg tror dig ikke uden et **bevis**.
sentence.en: I do not believe you without proof.

et bibliotek.explanation: "Et bibliotek" means "a library", a public place with shelves of books, newspapers and computers, where you can read or study. Many also lend films and music.

sentence.da: I et **bibliotek** kan man låne bøger gratis.
sentence.en: In a library you can borrow books for free.

et bibliotekskort.explanation: "Et bibliotekskort" means "a library card", the card you show to borrow books. It is built from bibliotek (library) and kort (card). Et kort also means a map: Jeg har et kort over byen (I have a map of the city).

sentence.da: Jeg viser mit **bibliotekskort** og låner tre bøger.
sentence.en: I show my library card and borrow three books.

et billede.explanation: "Et billede" means "a picture", such as a photo, a painting or an image on a screen. Say at tage et billede (to take a picture) and at hænge et billede op (to hang up a picture). Et foto (a photo) is more specific.

sentence.da: Hun maler et **billede** af havet.
sentence.en: She paints a picture of the sea.

et bjerg.explanation: "Et bjerg" means "a mountain". A smaller, lower one is en bakke (a hill). It is also part of longer words, like en bjergtur (a mountain trip).

sentence.da: Vi går op på et stort **bjerg**.
sentence.en: We walk up a big mountain.

et blad.explanation: "Et blad" means "a magazine" and also "a leaf": Hun læser et blad (She is reading a magazine). Træet har grønne blade (The tree has green leaves).

sentence.da: Jeg køber et **blad** med opskrifter og billeder.
sentence.en: I buy a magazine with recipes and pictures.

et blik.explanation: "Et blik" means "a look", a quick glance or the expression in someone's eyes: Han kastede et blik på uret (He glanced at the clock). Hun har et venligt blik (She has a kind look).

sentence.da: Hun så på mig med et trist **blik**.
sentence.en: She looked at me with a sad look.

et blinklys.explanation: "Et blinklys" means "a turn signal", the light that tells others you are about to turn. It is blink (blink) plus lys (light). The action is at blinke: Jeg blinker til højre (I signal right).

sentence.da: Husk at bruge **blinklys**, når du drejer.
sentence.en: Remember to use your turn signal when you turn.

et blåbær.explanation: "Et blåbær" means "a blueberry". It is built from blå (blue) and bær (berry), and the same blå is in en blåhval (a blue whale).

sentence.da: **Blåbær** er små, runde og blå.
sentence.en: Blueberries are small, round and blue.

et boardingpas.explanation: "Et boardingpas" means "a boarding pass", the paper or phone ticket you show to get on a plane. Do not mix it up with et pas (a passport).

sentence.da: Jeg viser mit **boardingpas** i lufthavnen.
sentence.en: I show my boarding pass at the airport.

et bogstav.explanation: "Et bogstav" means "a letter" of the alphabet, such as A, B or C. A letter you mail is et brev (a letter).

sentence.da: Hvilket **bogstav** kommer efter B?
sentence.en: Which letter comes after B?

et bord.explanation: "Et bord" means "a table". In a restaurant, you can ask Et bord til to, tak (A table for two, please). A desk is et skrivebord (literally a writing table).

sentence.da: Vi spiser ved et **bord** med fire stole.
sentence.en: We eat at a table with four chairs.

et brev.explanation: "Et brev" means "a letter" that you send in the post. For an email, say en mail (an email). At skrive et brev means "to write a letter".

sentence.da: Jeg sætter et frimærke på mit **brev**.
sentence.en: I put a stamp on my letter.

et brugernavn.explanation: "Et brugernavn" means "a username", the name you use to log in to a website or app. It is built from bruger (user) and navn (name), the same navn as in et fornavn (a first name).

sentence.da: Skriv dit **brugernavn** i feltet her.
sentence.en: Write your username in the field here.

et brusebad.explanation: "Et brusebad" means "a shower", the kind you take to wash. The verb is at tage (to take): Jeg tager et brusebad efter træning (I take a shower after exercise).

sentence.da: Efter et **brusebad** er jeg ren og frisk.
sentence.en: After a shower I am clean and fresh.

et bruseforhæng.explanation: "Et bruseforhæng" means "a shower curtain", a plastic or cloth curtain on a rail that you pull across the shower. It is built from bruse (to shower) and forhæng (curtain).

sentence.da: Et **bruseforhæng** holder vandet inde i badet.
sentence.en: A shower curtain keeps the water inside the shower.

et bryllup.explanation: "Et bryllup" means "a wedding". You can say you are going to one with til bryllup: Vi skal til bryllup (We are going to a wedding). At holde bryllup means "to hold a wedding".

sentence.da: Til et **bryllup** bærer bruden en hvid kjole.
sentence.en: At a wedding, the bride wears a white dress.

et bryst.explanation: "Et bryst" means "a chest", the front of the upper body, and it can also mean "a breast". Danish often says the chest instead of my chest: Jeg har smerter i brystet means "I have pain in my chest".

sentence.da: Hjertet slår i mit **bryst**.
sentence.en: The heart beats in my chest.

et bræt.explanation: "Et bræt" means "a board", a flat piece of wood. It is also part of brætspil (board game) and skærebræt (cutting board).

sentence.da: Jeg saver et **bræt** over med en sav.
sentence.en: I saw a board in two with a saw.

et brætspil.explanation: "Et brætspil" means "a board game", a game played on a board. It is built from bræt (board) and spil (game). Bræt also means a board in general, as in et skærebræt (a cutting board).

sentence.da: I et **brætspil** flytter man brikker rundt på brættet.
sentence.en: In a board game you move pieces around on the board.

et budget.explanation: "Et budget" means "a budget", a plan for what money comes in and goes out. To stay within it, say at overholde budgettet (to stick to the budget).

sentence.da: Vi har et lille **budget** til ferien.
sentence.en: We have a small budget for the vacation.

et busstoppested.explanation: "Et busstoppested" means "a bus stop". It is made from bus (bus) and stoppested (a place where something stops). People often shorten it to et stoppested (a stop).

sentence.da: Jeg venter på bussen ved et **busstoppested**.
sentence.en: I am waiting for the bus at a bus stop.

et bål.explanation: "Et bål" means "a bonfire" or "a campfire", an open fire outdoors: Vi tænder et bål på stranden (We light a fire on the beach). A fire that destroys things is en brand: Der er brand i huset (The house is on fire).

sentence.da: Vi sidder rundt om et **bål** og griller pølser.
sentence.en: We sit around a bonfire and grill sausages.

et bælte.explanation: "Et bælte" means "a belt", a strap you wear around your waist, usually to hold up trousers. Et sikkerhedsbælte (a seat belt) is built on the same word, from sikkerhed (safety).

sentence.da: Et **bælte** holder bukserne oppe.
sentence.en: A belt holds the trousers up.

et bær.explanation: "Et bær" means "a berry". Many berry names end in bær: jordbær (strawberry) and blåbær (blueberry).

sentence.da: Et **bær** vokser på en busk og er ofte sødt.
sentence.en: A berry grows on a bush and is often sweet.

et børneværelse.explanation: "Et børneværelse" means "a children's room", the room in a home where the kids sleep and play. It is built from børn (children) and værelse (room). Børne- also starts en børnebog (a children's book).

sentence.da: Der er mange bamser i vores **børneværelse**.
sentence.en: There are many teddy bears in our children's room.
